Class LegacyUlaApplicationCsvService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.LegacyUlaApplicationCsvService
@Service public class LegacyUlaApplicationCsvService extends Object
Imports the ULA application Google Form's response sheet, downloaded as CSV, into a ULA recruitment, one application per row, "as if" each student had entered it, so their next application can be pre-filled from it (issue #70). The ULA counterpart of LegacyApplicationCsvService.

Columns are found by the start of their header text (the form's question), so a reworded question still matches, and the grids (Course Preferences [24 (Mirza D)], Rate your familiarity with ... [Git/GitHub], Activity Interests [...]) by their bracketed label. A familiarity topic or activity the ULA topics or interests list does not have is added to the list, so the form shows the imported rating, and the result says what was added. The format is the one in docs/sample-data/legacy-ula-csv-example.csv, with the original or the condensed headers.
